visual_identity.core_identity: A massive land-shark-like burrowing beast with a plated body, prominent dorsal fin, four powerful legs, and a broad predatory head.
visual_identity.silhouette: Low barrel-bodied quadruped, high armored back with shark-like dorsal fin, thick forelegs, wedge-shaped head.
visual_identity.head_features: Broad blunt predatory head with heavy jaws, small eyes, and armored brow; no aquatic gills required.
visual_identity.body_shape: Four-legged compact powerhouse with deep chest, short thick neck, plated back, and digging claws.
visual_identity.surface: Large overlapping armor plates with sparse seams and minimal texture.
visual_identity.limb_structure: Exactly four powerful digging legs support the compact body, ending in heavy claws. One dorsal fin rises from the armored back; there are no wings, extra insect legs, or fish fins replacing limbs.
visual_identity.shape_lock: Draw one low barrel-bodied quadruped with exactly four thick digging legs, a wedge-shaped predatory head, broad armored back, and one obvious shark-like dorsal fin. The creature stays land-bound and massive rather than fish-shaped, serpentine, or six-legged.

accuracy_checks: reads as land predator not aquatic shark
body feels heavy and built for burrowing

reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.
